explication: GEO-SEO Claude is a Claude Code skill for auditing and improving websites for AI search while retaining SEO foundations. The principal workflow is: a user invokes the router, the audit discovers and fetches a target site, parallel agents analyze visibility, platforms, technical health, content, and schema, then reporting skills produce recommendations or PDFs. Separate commands score citability, inspect crawlers and llms.txt, scan brand presence, optimize prospects, generate proposals, and track monthly comparisons. Unsampled skill internals limit some wiring details.
